Messages.Body:
Can I use a Wake card to use Legacy of Power? Or does the minion

need to be unlocked?

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Legacy of Power:
Requires a ready prince, justicar or Inner Circle member.
Only usable when another vampire you control enters combat. Lock this reacting vampire and end combat. Each of the vampires involved in that combat goes to torpor.

Ruling:
[ANK 20200109] Is played during combat. Combat cards can be played to continue combat or begin a new combat.

As this card is played during combat, the wake effect coming from a reaction card should have been played just before the combat.
I would recommend you to tell the acting player that you use the wake reaction card before combat (wether or not the action is being blocked). The combat starts and you use the Legacy of Power.

Regards,
Rémi.

Messages.Author: Patrelcus
Messages.Body:
Check this sequence:

Player A acts

Player B blocks (or their vampire is being rushed)

Combat about to begin, Player B plays wake

Combat starts, Player B plays Legacy of Power

Is that correct?

Messages.Author: darksunami
Messages.Body: I just don't understand why you can't use Wake during combat; isn't it part of resolving the action?

The rulebook gives you the answer: The only minion cards that can be played during combat are combat cards.
